## Verified notes

Create with `POST /ARINV {"ID": "<customer>", "Details": [...]}`; EBMS assigns `INVOICE` and leaves `STATUS` `'U'`. Line fields: `INVEN`, `M_QUAN_VIS` (ordered), `M_SHIP_VIS` (shipped), `B_QUAN_VIS` (back-ordered), `UNIT_VIS` (price). Omit the price and EBMS applies the customer's price level, not the product's `BASE`. Edit lines only through the parent: `PATCH /ARINV('<AUTOID>') {"Details@delta": [{"@id": "<line AUTOID>", ...}, {"@id": "<line AUTOID>", "@removed": true}, {<new line>}]}`. Shipping does not set `B_QUAN_VIS`, and over-shipping is accepted without complaint. `PROCESS: "Process"` moves `STATUS` to `'O'` and locks the lines (403); `PROCESS: "Unprocess"` reverses it. A cash-terms order will not process until fully paid.

_From the human-maintained overlay/manual.json._
